```{r}

rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/USER/Downloads/data_reva_cabai.csv", sep = ";", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

df$Harga   <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", df$Harga))
df$Tanggal <- as.Date(df$Tanggal, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
df <- df[order(df$Tanggal), ]

cat("Jumlah observasi :", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Periode           :", format(min(df$Tanggal)), "s/d", format(max(df$Tanggal)), "\n")

harga <- df$Harga
n     <- length(harga)

ts_harga <- ts(harga, frequency = 5)

# EKSPLORASI DATA 
png("plot_data_asli.png", width = 900, height = 500)
plot(df$Tanggal, harga, type = "l", col = "steelblue", lwd = 2,
     main = "Harga Cabai Merah - Data Reva (100 Observasi)",
     xlab = "Tanggal", ylab = "Harga (Rp ribu/kg)")
grid()
dev.off()

# METODE 1: SINGLE MOVING AVERAGE (SMA) 
m <- 3  # orde pemulusan

sma <- function(x, m) {
  n <- length(x)
  out <- rep(NA, n)
  for (t in m:n) out[t] <- mean(x[(t - m + 1):t])
  out
}

SMA_t <- sma(harga, m)
# Fitted (ramalan 1 langkah ke depan): F_t = SMA_(t-1)
F_SMA <- c(NA, SMA_t[1:(n - 1)])

# METODE 2: DOUBLE MOVING AVERAGE (DMA)
Sp  <- sma(harga, m)     # S'_t : rata-rata bergerak tunggal
Spp <- sma(Sp, m)        # S''_t: rata-rata bergerak ganda (dari S')

a_t <- 2 * Sp - Spp
b_t <- (2 / (m - 1)) * (Sp - Spp)

# Fitted (ramalan 1 langkah ke depan): F_t = a_(t-1) + b_(t-1)*1
F_DMA <- c(NA, (a_t + b_t)[1:(n - 1)])

# METODE 3: SINGLE EXPONENTIAL SMOOTHING (SES) 
ses_fit <- HoltWinters(ts_harga, beta = FALSE, gamma = FALSE)
alpha_opt <- ses_fit$alpha
F_SES <- c(rep(NA, n - length(fitted(ses_fit)[, "xhat"])), fitted(ses_fit)[, "xhat"])

# METODE 4: DOUBLE EXPONENTIAL SMOOTHING / HOLT (DES) 
des_fit <- HoltWinters(ts_harga, gamma = FALSE)
alpha_des <- des_fit$alpha
beta_des  <- des_fit$beta
F_DES <- c(rep(NA, n - length(fitted(des_fit)[, "xhat"])), fitted(des_fit)[, "xhat"])

# METODE 5: HOLT-WINTERS (dengan komponen musiman) 
hw_fit <- HoltWinters(ts_harga, seasonal = "additive")
F_HW <- c(rep(NA, n - length(fitted(hw_fit)[, "xhat"])), fitted(hw_fit)[, "xhat"])

# PERHITUNGAN METRIK AKURASI 
start_idx <- max(which(!is.na(F_SMA))[1],
                  which(!is.na(F_DMA))[1],
                  which(!is.na(F_SES))[1],
                  which(!is.na(F_DES))[1],
                  which(!is.na(F_HW))[1])

idx <- start_idx:n
aktual <- harga[idx]

hitung_metrik <- function(aktual, prediksi) {
  e    <- aktual - prediksi
  sse  <- sum(e^2)
  mse  <- mean(e^2)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  mape <- mean(abs(e / aktual)) * 100
  c(SSE = sse, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAPE = mape)
}

hasil <- rbind(
  SMA          = hitung_metrik(aktual, F_SMA[idx]),
  DMA          = hitung_metrik(aktual, F_DMA[idx]),
  SES          = hitung_metrik(aktual, F_SES[idx]),
  `DES (Holt)` = hitung_metrik(aktual, F_DES[idx]),
  `Holt-Winters` = hitung_metrik(aktual, F_HW[idx])
)

cat("\nRentang evaluasi   : titik ke-", start_idx, "sampai ke-", n,
    " (", length(idx), "observasi )\n")
cat("\n=== TABEL PERBANDINGAN AKURASI ===\n")
print(round(hasil, 4))

metode_terbaik <- rownames(hasil)[which.min(hasil[, "MSE"])]
cat("\nMetode terbaik (MSE terkecil):", metode_terbaik, "\n")

# VISUALISASI PERBANDINGAN 
png("plot_perbandingan.png", width = 1000, height = 600)
plot(idx, aktual, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 2,
     main = "Perbandingan Aktual vs Hasil Pemulusan",
     xlab = "Periode ke-", ylab = "Harga (Rp ribu/kg)")
lines(idx, F_SMA[idx], col = "red",     lwd = 1.5)
lines(idx, F_DMA[idx], col = "orange",  lwd = 1.5)
lines(idx, F_SES[idx], col = "forestgreen", lwd = 1.5)
lines(idx, F_DES[idx], col = "purple",  lwd = 1.5)
lines(idx, F_HW[idx],  col = "deepskyblue4", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Aktual", "SMA", "DMA", "SES", "DES (Holt)", "Holt-Winters"),
       col = c("black", "red", "orange", "forestgreen", "purple", "deepskyblue4"),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
dev.off()
```
